name: portal-amarante-csc
description: Portal Amarante CSC — scripts de orquestração do mono-repo

scripts.setup: bash database/scripts/setup.sh && bash database/scripts/migrate.sh && bash database/scripts/check.sh
scripts.dev: npm run dev:stop && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
